notes: Captured from the live CISA feed (catalogVersion 2026.11.09, 1,773 entries, ETag and Last-Modified as sent by www.cisa.gov) and trimmed to the 150 most recently added entries plus the 5 oldest ones (2021-11-03), in upstream order.
